question.text: Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs) are registered with:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.6, CTAs are registered with National Futures Association (NFA) in USA. The Trap: SEBI regulates India; FCA is UK; IOSCO is a global body. Cross-Exam Context: Managed Futures is distinct from traditional AIF strategies. Distributor's Pro-Tip: CTAs use systematic or discretionary managed futures — often found in multi-strategy Cat III AIFs globally.
